strategy_roster.name: Keltner RSI Divergence
strategy_roster.notes: Keltner channel uses the documented EmaPeriod 20, AtrPeriod 14 and AtrMultiplier 2.0, and a rising RSI(14) stands in for the divergence check because true divergence detection is not in the DSL. The documented ATR-multiple stop is an indicator stop, not a percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Live Alligator
strategy_roster.notes: Alligator lips/teeth/jaw are approximated by EMAs of median price at 5/8/13 because SMMA is unavailable; lips crossing above the jaw with teeth still below matches the documented long. TrailPeriod is undocumented so 13 is the fallback, and the five-EMA confirmation, line shifts and trading-hours filter are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Double AI Super Trend Trading
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,10) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,10) and close > ema(close,20) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,20) and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Two SuperTrends are approximated by close above an EMA plus an ATR multiple, and the price-WMA confirmation by close above SMA(20). The 10/20 periods and the multiplier 3 are explicit fallbacks since no SuperTrend or WMA parameters are documented, and the ATR trailing stop is an indicator stop.

strategy_roster.name: TSI DeMarker
strategy_roster.notes: TSI is expressed as a MACD of DeMarker, where DeMarker is approximated by RSI(25) and the documented ShortLength 5, LongLength 8 and SignalLength 20 are used verbatim. The exit is the documented opposite cross and the docs state there are no stops.

strategy_roster.name: EF Distance Reversal
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(sma(close,10),2) < 0 and roc(sma(close,10),1) > 0 and atr(high,low,close,20) >= 0.01 * close
strategy_roster.notes: The three-consecutive-SMA local bottom is captured with the documented SMA 10 over two and one bars plus the ATR(20) volatility filter; the documented threshold of 1 is unitless, so 1% of price is the fallback. Documented StopLoss 100 and TakeProfit 200 are price points, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Short Interest Effect
strategy_roster.notes: The signal is a monthly cross-sectional ranking of short interest and days-to-cover, which the DSL cannot derive from OHLCV, so no entry is fabricated. Portfolio rebalancing and the fundamental inputs are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: VR MARS
strategy_roster.notes: This is a port of a manual trading panel that only picks one of five lot sizes and fires a market buy or sell on start, with the docs stating it implements no trading logic. Lot selection and the start-time order flags are not market-derived signals.

strategy_roster.name: Overnight Sentiment Anomaly
strategy_roster.notes: Entry depends on an external end-of-day sentiment series crossing a configurable Threshold, plus a session-close to next-open hold, neither of which is available in the DSL. MinTradeUsd sizing is not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Breakeven Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: This is a position-management demo that opens long on the first finished candle and then only moves a breakeven and trailing stop in points. There is no market-derived entry signal, so no fake one is invented.

strategy_roster.name: Nadaraya-Watson Envelope
strategy_roster.notes: The Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression in log scale is approximated by the documented LookbackWindow 8 as an SMA with a dispersion band; the 0.5 band width is a fallback because RelativeWeighting 8 is a smoothing weight, not an offset. Long-only mode keeps only the lower-envelope cross in and the upper-envelope cross out.
